description.value: The Clarion Hotel & Conference Centre is a full-service hotel in Abbotsford featuring newly renovated rooms and suites alongside a large conference and events facility. Guests have access to an indoor heated pool, hot tub, and a fitness centre with cardio equipment. The on-site White Spot restaurant — a beloved BC institution — serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner, making it a convenient base for a cycling stop in the Fraser Valley.
